name: Barbell Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with your chest against the pad, rest both upper arms flat, and grip a barbell palms up.
Start with your arms extended down the pad with a slight unlock at the elbows.
Curl the bar smoothly upward toward your shoulders by flexing strictly at the elbows.
Lower the bar slowly back to near full extension without bouncing out of the bottom.
tips: Keep the backs of your upper arms pressed firmly into the pad throughout each repetition.
Keep your wrists straight and avoid leaning backward to heave the bar upward.
